name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 8 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2025-10-23, at wavelengths from 1.19 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
